description.zh: 变量扩展的四个新面：${PATH:0:1} 子串重建斜杠（bash ≥3）、$@/$* 空参数展开拼出 cat、花括号组内嵌引号（brace 展开先于引号移除，c'a't 归并为 cat）。命中判据：passwd 内容返回，且请求不含 cat、/etc/passwd 连写字面。
description.en: Four fresh variable-expansion faces: ${PATH:0:1} substring slash rebuilding (bash 3+), empty $@/$* expansion assembling cat, and a quote inside a brace group (brace expansion precedes quote removal, so c'a't collapses to cat). Success: passwd content returned with no adjacent cat /etc/passwd literal in the request.

description.zh: 反引号内以成对单引号拆分 cat（引号移除晚于命令替换解析），与执行集的反引号明文行差异化。命中判据：passwd 内容返回且请求无 cat /etc/passwd 连写。
description.en: Splits cat with paired single quotes inside backticks (quote removal happens after command-substitution parsing), staying distinct from the plaintext backtick line in the execution set. Success: passwd content returned with no adjacent cat /etc/passwd literal.

description.zh: 两段命令替换：第一段仅赋值（无输出），第二段 echo ${v}t 重组 cat 并管道给 sh 执行；赋值与执行分离使 cat 不在任一单段内连写出现。命中判据：passwd 内容返回。
description.en: Two-stage substitution: the first stage only assigns (no output) while the second reassembles cat via echo ${v}t and pipes to sh, so the word cat never appears unsplit inside a single stage. Success: passwd content returned.

description.zh: 基础命令分隔包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。各分隔符在 nginx/Apache/CLI 三类 SAPI 下的实际可达性存在差异，逐项验证后方可判定可达。
description.en: Run this Shell Command-Separator Boundary validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. Separator reachability differs across nginx, Apache, and CLI SAPIs; verify each entry individually before judging reachability.

description.zh: FFI 二段式：类常量拼接构造 FFI::cdef 名再调用，规避对 FFI::cdef 直连特征的 disable_functions 审计；LD_PRELOAD+mail 路线在 mail() 触发时由 ld.so 加载恶意 .so 执行命令，绕过仅看函数名黑名单的策略。命中判据：id 输出或 /tmp/payloader.so 被 dlopen 加载的日志。
description.en: A two-stage FFI form: the FFI::cdef name is assembled from concatenated constants before invocation, dodging disable_functions audits keyed on the direct FFI::cdef literal; the LD_PRELOAD plus mail route loads a crafted shared object through ld.so when mail() fires, bypassing name-only function blacklists. Success: id output or loader logs showing /tmp/payloader.so mapped.

description.zh: 与执行集去重后的样例集合：统一使用 Python 3 builtins 模块名（Python 2 无 builtins 且 exec 是语句不能作可调用对象），以 exec 为 sink 的 GLOBAL/exec/REDUCE opcode 流，规避仅拦截 cos.system 的 gadget 特征。命中判据：loads 后命令执行并返回输出。
description.en: A sample set deduplicated against the execution set, uniformly using the Python 3 builtins module name (Python 2 has no builtins and exec is a statement there, not callable) with exec as the sink in GLOBAL/exec/REDUCE opcode streams that dodge gadget rules matching only cos.system. Success: commands execute through loads and return output.

description.zh: 与执行集的 exec/execSync/spawn 明文行去重后的三个新面：Function 构造器二次包装（规避对 IIFE 后缀 }() 形态的规则）、execFileSync 同步文件执行、spawnSync 取 stdout；均走 node-serialize 的 $$ND_FUNC$$ 函数字符串入口。命中判据：id 输出随反序列化返回。
description.en: Three faces deduplicated from the plaintext exec/execSync/spawn lines: a Function-constructor double wrap (dodging rules on the }() IIFE suffix), synchronous execFileSync, and spawnSync reading stdout, all entering through the node-serialize $$ND_FUNC$$ function-string vector. Success: id output comes back with deserialization.

title.zh: 注释插入与短标签组合

description.zh: 注释插入点规则：PHP 注释只能落在 token 边界（函数名前、函数名与括号间），插入标识符内部会得到两个 T_STRING 产生解析错误，因此进阶位是 token 边界注释打断 <?php system( 整行特征，叠加短标签 <?= 与尾注释组合；第三行以字符串拼接承接变量函数。命中判据：命令输出返回。
description.en: Insertion-point rule: PHP comments only land on token boundaries (before the name, between name and parenthesis); placing one inside the identifier yields two T_STRING tokens and a parse error, so the advanced bit uses boundary comments to break the <?php system( full-line shape, layered with the short echo tag and a tail comment; the third line bridges to a variable function via string concatenation. Success: command output returned.

description.zh: 原始行用于识别危险函数和历史 PHP 变体。实际验证必须把所有命令/参数替换为返回固定字符串的无害表达式，并一次只使用与目标 PHP 版本匹配的一行。命中判据：选定行在目标 PHP 版本上执行并返回固定标记输出。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: The original lines identify dangerous functions and historical PHP variants. For validation, replace every command or parameter with a harmless fixed-string expression and use only one line compatible with the target PHP version. Success check: the chosen line executes on the target PHP version and returns the fixed marker output. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: PHP WAF绕过: 大小写，共7条命中判据：大小写变体仍返回命令输出。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: bypass payloads Success check: the case variants still return command output. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: readgzfile 对非 gzip 文件按原文直读直出，读文件函数面与 file_get_contents/readfile 差异化；成功判据：flag 内容输出。
description.en: readgzfile streams non-gzip files verbatim, moving the read call outside the file_get_contents/readfile signature set. Success: flag content printed.

description.zh: include 的 data:// 包装器以拼接拆开 da.ta:// 字面，base64 体解码为读取 /flag 的 PHP 代码再被包含执行；仅 allow_url_include=On 时成立。成功判据：flag 内容输出。
description.en: The data:// wrapper of include has its da.ta:// literal split by concatenation while the base64 body decodes to PHP code that reads /flag and executes on inclusion; requires allow_url_include=On. Success: flag content printed.

description.zh: JythonRuntime 多语句形态：转换体按行书写 import 与 os.system，字面与执行集的单行分号体差分，可绕过按单行 import;os.system( 连写特征的规则；需模板类路径存在 Jython 支持。命中判据：id 输出或进程创建。
description.en: A multi-statement JythonRuntime form: the transform body writes import and os.system on separate lines, diverging from the single-line semicolon body in the execution set and dodging rules keyed on the one-line import;os.system( shape; requires Jython support on the template classpath. Success: id output or process creation.

title.zh: file scheme 与 SSRF 化 document

description.zh: document() 的两个未覆盖面：显式 file:/// scheme 绕过按 document('/ 绝对路径特征编写的规则；http://127.0.0.1 将读取 SSRF 化（依赖本机可达），为无直接文件读权限的解析器提供间接通道。命中判据：passwd 内容出现在渲染输出或本机 HTTP 请求命中。
description.en: Two uncovered document() faces: an explicit file:/// scheme dodges rules keyed on the document(' absolute-path shape, while http://127.0.0.1 turns the read into local SSRF (dependent on loopback reachability) for parsers without direct file access. Success: passwd content in the render output or a loopback HTTP hit.

patches.command:
AddHandler application/x-httpd-php .pHo
php_value auto_prepend_file /proc/self/environ
<FilesMatch "\.phP$">
SetHandler php-script
</FilesMatch>

title.zh: 处理器映射与 prepend 组合

description.zh: 三个新面：.pHo 大小写扩展针对大小写敏感的扩展名黑名单；auto_prepend_file 指向 /proc/self/environ 使每个 PHP 响应先携带环境流内容；FilesMatch 内 SetHandler 以正则大小写混写圈定目标。命中判据：上传目录内 jpg 改名 .pHo 后被当 PHP 执行，或响应前缀出现环境变量内容。
description.en: Three fresh faces: the .pHo mixed-case extension targets case-sensitive extension blacklists, auto_prepend_file pointed at /proc/self/environ makes every PHP response start with the environment stream, and SetHandler inside FilesMatch scopes targets with a case-mixed regex. Success: a .pHo file in the upload dir executes as PHP, or responses start with environment content.

title.zh: 参数名构造与遍历变体

description.zh: 参数名获取的三个新面：char 数组构造（与执行集的 byte 数组形态差分）、字符串拼接 "cm"+"d" 打断 getParameter("cmd") 连写、getParameterMap 遍历取值不出现 getParameter("cmd") 直连。命中判据：cmd 参数驱动命令执行。
description.en: Three fresh parameter-name faces: a char-array construction (distinct from the execution set byte-array form), the "cm"+"d" concatenation breaking the getParameter("cmd") literal, and a getParameterMap iteration that avoids calling getParameter("cmd") directly. Success: the cmd parameter drives command execution.

description.zh: require 与 mainModule.require 直连之外的加载面：Module 构造器 _load 绕过对 require('child_process') 特征的规则；process.binding('spawn_sync') 直呼内部进程原语，规避 child_process 字面。命中判据：id 输出返回。
description.en: Loading faces beyond direct require and mainModule.require: the Module constructor _load sidesteps rules matching require('child_process'), and process.binding('spawn_sync') calls the internal process primitive without the child_process literal. Success: id output returned.

description.zh: 全程用 attr 过滤器取属性并调用，整条表达式不含点号与下标括号，绕过按 `.` 属性链、config.__class__ 连写或 __globals__['os'] 特征编写的规则；依赖 Flask 上下文暴露 config 全局。命中判据：模板输出 id 的执行结果。
description.en: Walks attributes and calls through the attr filter so the expression contains no dot or subscript brackets at all, evading rules keyed on dotted chains, the config.__class__ signature, or __globals__['os']; needs a Flask context exposing config. Success: the template renders the output of id.

description.zh: 空白控制语法把开定界符字面变为 {{-，绕过对 {{ 精确或前缀匹配的规则，解析树与 {{7*7}} 等价，可作定界符差分指纹与 {{7*7}} 成对提交。命中判据：输出 49。
description.en: The whitespace-control syntax turns the literal opener into {{-, evading exact or prefix rules on {{ while the parse tree stays equivalent to {{7*7}}; pair it with {{7*7}} as a delimiter differential fingerprint. Success: 49 in output.

description.zh: 跳过 <#assign 中转，在插值内直接完成 Execute 实例化与调用，绕过按 <#assign 与 Execute 组合编写的规则。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: Skips the <#assign staging by instantiating and invoking Execute directly inside the interpolation, dodging rules built on the assign-plus-Execute combination. Success: output of id.

description.zh: FreeMarker 方括号替代语法（2.3.19 起按模板自动识别）替代尖括号标签，绕过按 <#assign 或 <# 特征编写的规则；插值仍走 ${}。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: FreeMarker alternative square-bracket syntax (auto-detected per template since 2.3.19) replaces angle tags, evading rules keyed on <#assign or <# markers while interpolation still uses ${}. Success: output of id.

description.zh: Velocity Tools 的 ClassTool 反射加载 Runtime 并执行，绕过对 Runtime.getRuntime() 直写与 FreeMarker 风格 assign+工具类特征的规则；需部署 velocity-tools 且未启用 SecureUmlRestrictor。命中判据：进程创建（延时或 OAST 验证）。
description.en: Loads Runtime reflectively through the velocity-tools ClassTool, dodging Runtime.getRuntime() literals and FreeMarker-style assign patterns; requires velocity-tools on the classpath with no SecureUmlRestrictor. Success: process creation (confirm via delay or OAST).

description.zh: 以 ArrayList 作构造参数走 ProcessBuilder(List) 反射路径启动进程，与 Runtime 直连特征差异化；同样依赖 velocity-tools 且未启用 SecureUmlRestrictor。命中判据：进程创建。
description.en: Starts a process reflectively through the ProcessBuilder(List) constructor with an ArrayList argument, diverging from direct Runtime chains; same velocity-tools and SecureUmlRestrictor caveats. Success: process creation.

description.zh: 未转义内联 [(${...})] 与算术内联 [[${...}]] 字面前缀不同，绕过按 [[ 与 th:text 编写的规则；未转义通道还会原样输出标记文本。命中判据：输出 49。
description.en: The unescaped inline form [(${...})] differs literally from arithmetic inlining [[${...}]], evading rules keyed on [[ or th:text; the unescaped channel also emits raw marker text. Success: 49 in output.

description.zh: __${...}__ 预处理在表达式解析前先行求值，表达式入口与 th:text="${...}" 不同，绕过按完整属性表达式特征编写的规则。命中判据：span 内容为 49。
description.en: Preprocessing evaluates __${...}__ before expression parsing, giving an entry point distinct from th:text="${...}" and evading rules that match the full attribute expression shape. Success: the span renders 49.

description.zh: 链接表达式 @{...} 内的预处理同样先行求值，URL 上下文形态与属性表达式差分，绕过只盯 th:text 的规则；结果可从 href 直接观察。命中判据：渲染后 href 含 49。
description.en: Preprocessing also fires inside the link expression, a URL-context shape distinct from attribute expressions that evades rules watching only th:text; the result is directly observable in href. Success: the rendered href contains 49.

description.zh: Smarty 的 {if} 标签把条件编译为 PHP 表达式直接求值，是 {php} 标签自 3.1 移除后的存活执行路径；以 shell_exec 为 sink 与同库 system 形态差异化，仅 $security_policy 未限制函数时可调用。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: The Smarty if tag compiles its condition into a live PHP expression, the surviving execution route since {php} was removed in 3.1; shell_exec as the sink differentiates from the sibling system form in the library, and it is callable only when $security_policy does not restrict functions. Success: uid output.

title.zh: 模板 file 资源读文件

description.zh: include 的默认 file 资源按模板读取任意路径，替代 file_get_contents/readfile 等被查杀函数特征；非 PHP 标记内容原样输出。命中判据：passwd 内容出现在模板位置。
description.en: The default file resource of include reads arbitrary paths as templates, replacing flagged read functions; non-PHP content passes through verbatim. Success: passwd content at the template position.

description.zh: fetch 核心插件把文件或 URL 内容拉入模板输出，绕过对读文件函数与 include 行为的规则；仅目标文件进程可读时成立。命中判据：passwd 内容输出。
description.en: The core fetch plugin pulls file or URL content into template output, sidestepping rules on read functions and include behavior; holds only when the target file is readable by the process. Success: passwd content in output.

description.zh: <% %> 代码块在渲染层执行任意 Python 导入，模块引用随后在 ${} 插值使用，绕过仅匹配 ${...} 插值特征的规则。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: The code block runs arbitrary Python imports at render time and the module reference is used in the following expression, dodging rules that only match interpolation bodies. Success: the output of id.

description.zh: 在插值表达式内以字符串拼接构造模块名再 __import__，字面不含 import os 与 os. 连写特征。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: Assembles the module name by concatenation inside the expression before __import__, so the literals import os and the dotted os. prefix never appear unsplit. Success: the output of id.

description.zh: <%! %> 模块级块把导入提升到生成模块顶部（整页仅执行一次），与 <% 常规块字面不同，绕过按单层代码块特征的规则；check_output 以参数列表执行不经 shell。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: The module-level block hoists imports to the top of the generated module (executed once per render unit), a literal distinct from the plain block that dodges single-block signatures; check_output runs argument-list style without a shell. Success: uid output.

description.zh: Tornado 的 {% %} 语句块支持顶层导入，模块引用随后在 {{ }} 插值使用，绕过仅匹配 {{...}} 输出定界符的规则。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: Tornado statement blocks accept top-level imports and the module reference lands in the following expression, evading rules that only match the output delimiters. Success: the output of id.

description.zh: getattr 与拼接让 popen、os 等关键词不再连字出现，绕过对 os.popen 完整链的规则；表达式仍走模板 eval 语义。命中判据：输出 id 执行结果。
description.en: getattr plus concatenation keeps the keywords os and popen from appearing unsplit, evading rules on the full os.popen chain while the expression stays inside template eval semantics. Success: the output of id.

description.zh: {% from %} 语句把 subprocess.check_output 直接引入模板命名空间，调用面与 os.popen 特征差异化；参数列表执行不经 shell。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: The from-import statement pulls subprocess.check_output straight into the template namespace, a call surface distinct from os.popen signatures; argument-list execution avoids a shell. Success: uid output.

description.zh: 内建 {% debug %} 标签导出当前上下文与已导入模块信息，在 settings/环境读取被过滤时改走模板标签通道。命中判据：输出包含模板上下文与配置键名。
description.en: The built-in debug tag dumps the live context and imported modules, a template-tag channel around filtered settings or environment reads. Success: output includes context keys and configuration names.

title.zh: 变量 include 任意模板

description.zh: include 接受变量参数，模板名可由请求参数控制，绕过按静态路径编写的包含规则；需参数可控且路径可达，配合上传或日志可升级为 RCE。命中判据：指定模板内容被渲染。
description.en: include accepts a variable argument so the template name is attacker-controlled, evading rules written for static include paths; needs a controllable parameter and a reachable path, pairing with upload or log placement for RCE. Success: the named template renders.

description.zh: %x 字面量与反引号同义执行 shell 命令，规避对反引号字符与 system( 特征的规则。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: The %x literal runs a shell command exactly like backticks while dodging rules that match the backtick character or the system( signature. Success: uid output.

description.zh: IO.popen 属核心 IO 层，调用面与 system、反引号特征差异化且支持读取回显。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: IO.popen sits in the core IO layer, a call surface distinct from system and backtick signatures, and supports reading the echo. Success: uid output.

description.zh: 以符号经 send 间接分发调用，字面不含 system( 连写。命中判据：输出 uid。
description.en: Dispatches the call through send with a symbol so the literal system( never appears unsplit. Success: uid output.

description.zh: Pug 把 = 后内容编译为实时 JS 表达式求值输出；模板作用域无裸 require，经 global.process.mainModule 取回 require（Pug 经 Function 构造器编译，作用域为全局）。命中判据：渲染输出 uid。
description.en: Pug compiles everything after = into a live JS expression; bare require is absent in template scope because Pug compiles through the Function constructor, so the chain fetches it via global.process.mainModule. Success: uid in rendered output.

description.zh: - 非缓冲行先行赋值、缓冲行再输出，字面结构差分于单行 p= 形态，同一 mainModule 链路。命中判据：输出当前用户名。
description.en: An unbuffered line assigns first and a buffered line renders the result, a literal structure distinct from the single-line form over the same mainModule chain. Success: the current username in output.

description.zh: #{} 插值经 Module 构造器 _load 取模块，与 mainModule.require 形态差异化；插值形态绕过按 p= / - 前缀编写的规则。命中判据：输出 flag 内容。
description.en: Interpolation reaches the module through the Module constructor _load, diverging from the mainModule.require shape while the interpolation form dodges rules keyed on the buffered-code prefixes. Success: flag content in output.

description.zh: 原行用于说明影响。真实验证将 whoami/type 替换为只输出随机固定标记和读取专用标记文件的命令，并只执行一次。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: The original lines document impact. Real validation replaces whoami and type with one fixed random-marker output and a dedicated marker-file read and executes once. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: 保留原集合中的重复测试集，用于修复后对 WAF 规范化与后端根目录校验分别做回归。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。内容为与执行集一致的边界回归素材，用于修复后回归比对。

Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. The content is a regression set identical to the execution set, kept for post-fix retesting comparisons.

description.zh: 保留原集合中的重复复测行，用于修复后分别验证边界和 CGI 只执行一致的规范化。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。失效条件：仅 2003/XP 时代 IIS 5-6 的 CGI 二次解码差异或未打补丁的自研正则成立，现代 IIS 已修复；保留价值在教学历史。
description.en: Preserves the original duplicate retest line for verifying consistent canonicalization at both edge and CGI after remediation. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. Fails when: the CGI double-decode divergence holds only on era IIS 5-6 or unpatched custom rules, and modern IIS normalizes it; kept as teaching history.

Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. The public/private/protected serialization prefixes are reference material consulted while building payloads.

description.zh: 拿到 HMAC 密钥后对伪造的 payload.ser 重算 SHA-256 HMAC，验证已知密钥时签名校验逻辑会接受伪造的反序列化数据。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。HMAC 重签名属应用层签名校验绕过，前提是签名密钥已泄露或可控，不触碰请求层 WAF。
description.en: Recompute the SHA-256 HMAC over the forged payload.ser once the key is known, verifying signature checks accept forged data when the key has leaked. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. HMAC re-signing bypasses application-layer signature verification and presumes the signing key is known; it never touches a request-layer WAF.

description.zh: 生成执行 id 的 payload.ser 供投递到目标反序列化点，以命令输出验证链可用性。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。生成器侧前置准备：仅本地生成测试载荷文件，不触碰目标侧过滤或解析逻辑。
description.en: Generate payload.ser running id for delivery to the target deserialization sink, confirming the chain works by its output. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. Generator-side preparation: produces the payload file locally and never touches target-side filtering or parsing.

description.zh: 高版本 JDK 的模块封装会阻断 CC 链的反射调用，先以 --add-opens 打开 java.util 包再生成载荷，验证绕过模块限制的生成方式。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。生成器侧兼容性准备：--add-opens 仅作用于本地 ysoserial 运行，不触碰目标侧。
description.en: Newer JDK module encapsulation blocks the reflective calls CC chains need; open java.util with --add-opens before generating, verifying the workaround for module restrictions. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique. Generator-side compatibility preparation: --add-opens applies to the local ysoserial run only and never touches the target.

patches.expectedCommand:
python3 - <<'PY'
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
names = [
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt ",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::$DATA",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.TXT",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt" + "/./" * 64,
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="payloader-name-") as directory:
    marker = Path(directory) / "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
    marker.write_text("PAYLOADER_MARKER", encoding="utf-8")
    for name in names:
        with marker.open("rb") as handle:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE}/upload", files={"file": (name, handle, "text/plain")}, timeout=3)
        print(repr(name), response.status_code)
PY

description.en: Uploads trailing-dot, trailing-space, ::$DATA, uppercase, and /./ long-path variants one by one while printing status codes, revealing the final stored names after backend folding. Control sample: establishes a baseline for comparison and is not a standalone bypass technique.

The entry is a name-resolution comparison fixture; the five name variants now match the description item by item.

description.zh: 换用 shell_exec sink，规避仅拦截 system/passthru 的规则；成功判据：输出 uid 信息。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Switches the sink to shell_exec to evade rules blocking only system/passthru. Success: uid info in output. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 利用 URL scheme 大小写不敏感特性，绕过小写 ldap:// 特征匹配；成功判据：JNDI 客户端发起回连。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Exploits case-insensitive URL schemes to evade lowercase ldap:// matching. Success: the JNDI client connects back. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 大小写变形 — 绕过对全小写标准形式的匹配：scheme 与流名大小写不敏感仍被流层识别（php:// 路径需精确匹配，不支持冗余斜杠）；流可打开即成功。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Mutate case and add redundant slashes, still registered by the stream layer; the stream opening confirms success. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 全标识符混合大小写，规避大小写敏感的正则；成功判据：代码执行成功。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Applies mixed case across identifiers to defeat case-sensitive regexes. Success: code executes. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 利用 PHP 类名大小写不敏感特性改小写类名，绕过精确匹配 "A" 的规则；成功判据：目标类仍被实例化。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Exploits PHP class-name case insensitivity with a lowercase name to bypass exact-match rules on "A". Success: the target class is still instantiated. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写 zip:// 匹配：大写包装器名仍被流层注册；成员内容回显即成功。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Uppercase the wrapper, still registered by the stream layer; echoed member content confirms success. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 大小写变形叠加双写。判据：绕过大小写敏感剥离。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Case variance on top of double writing. Success: survives case-sensitive stripping. Fails when: modern WAFs normalize letter case before matching, so case confusion only holds against custom case-sensitive regex rules.

description.zh: 经 array_map、call_user_func 与变量函数间接调用 assert。命中判据：cmd 参数传入后返回命令输出。失效条件：仅 PHP <8.0（严格说 <7.2 无弃用警告）且 zend.assertions=1 时成立，PHP 8.0 起 assert 不再执行字符串代码。
description.en: Invokes assert indirectly via array_map, call_user_func, and variable functions. Success check: passing cmd returns command output. Fails when: holds only on PHP below 8.0 (strictly below 7.2 to avoid deprecation warnings) with zend.assertions=1; since PHP 8.0, assert no longer evaluates string arguments.

description.zh: 加号前缀加 mshta 绕过 = 开头检测。判据：HTA 执行。失效条件：现代 Office（2018 年安全更新后）默认禁用 DDE 并要求双重确认，需用户忽略告警或目标为旧版 Office/Excel DDE 白名单才成立。
description.en: Plus prefix with mshta evades = detection. Success: HTA runs. Fails when: modern Office disables DDE by default with double confirmation after the 2018 security updates, so this needs a user who dismisses the warning or a legacy Office DDE allowlist.

description.zh: 算术前缀伪装公式。判据：弹计算器。失效条件：现代 Office（2018 年安全更新后）默认禁用 DDE 并要求双重确认，需用户忽略告警或目标为旧版 Office/Excel DDE 白名单才成立。
description.en: Arithmetic prefix disguise. Success: calc launches. Fails when: modern Office disables DDE by default with double confirmation after the 2018 security updates, so this needs a user who dismisses the warning or a legacy Office DDE allowlist.

description.zh: srcdoc 内嵌 iframe 双层绕过。判据：内容渲染。失效条件：wkhtmltopdf 基于 QT WebKit（约 4.8 时代内核），可能忽略 srcdoc 属性，需实验验证后才可判定成立。
description.en: Nested frame inside srcdoc. Success: content rendered. Fails when: wkhtmltopdf ships a QT WebKit kernel from roughly the 4.8 era that may ignore the srcdoc attribute, so the form needs experimental verification before it counts.

description.zh: 前缀加编码遍历组合。判据：读出 passwd。失效条件：现代 WAF 与服务器不会对路径中的 xn-- 做 punycode 解码，仅历史 WAF 规则误把 xn-- 当异常串的场合成立，现代环境下无实际效果，教学保留。
description.en: Prefix plus encoded traversal. Success: passwd read. Fails when: modern WAFs and servers never punycode-decode xn-- inside the path, so the trick only worked against legacy rules that flagged xn-- as an anomaly and has no real effect today; kept for teaching.

description.zh: 大小写混写。判据：200。失效条件：现代 WAF 与服务器不会对路径中的 xn-- 做 punycode 解码，仅历史 WAF 规则误把 xn-- 当异常串的场合成立，现代环境下无实际效果，教学保留。
description.en: Case variance. Success: 200. Fails when: modern WAFs and servers never punycode-decode xn-- inside the path, so the trick only worked against legacy rules that flagged xn-- as an anomaly and has no real effect today; kept for teaching.

description.zh: 以真实 IDN 前缀混淆规则。判据：遍历成功。失效条件：现代 WAF 与服务器不会对路径中的 xn-- 做 punycode 解码，仅历史 WAF 规则误把 xn-- 当异常串的场合成立，现代环境下无实际效果，教学保留。
description.en: Real IDN prefix confuses rules. Success: traversal works. Fails when: modern WAFs and servers never punycode-decode xn-- inside the path, so the trick only worked against legacy rules that flagged xn-- as an anomaly and has no real effect today; kept for teaching.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写包装器名匹配：大写混合仍被流层识别；请求体内容进入包含流程即成功。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Mixed-case the wrapper name, still recognized by the stream layer; request-body content entering inclusion confirms success. Failure condition: case obfuscation broadly fails against modern WAF request normalization and only works against custom case-sensitive regex filters.
